canonical_equations: Gather valid in-bounds cells, sort numerically; odd median=middle; even median=RN32(RN32(lower*0.5)+RN32(upper*0.5)); no in-place propagation.
input_contract: encoding=binary32-hex; mesh,valid[H,W],H/W1..64,valid uint0/1; window odd1..7; minimum_valid1..window^2; finite f32 values.
output_contract: H*W x [u32 status,count,f32 median]; status1 count<minimum_valid and median0; status0 success; boundary window truncated, signed zero canonicalized; no uncertainty inference.
result_contract: H*W x [u32 status,count,f32 median]; status1 count<minimum_valid and median0; status0 success; boundary window truncated, signed zero canonicalized; no uncertainty inference.
precision_requirements: Finite IEEE binary32 values, explicitly supplied as eight hex digits (encoding=binary32-hex). Every +,-,*,/,sqrt rounds to nearest ties-to-even; gradual underflow; canonical positive zero after arithmetic. No FMA or reassociation. Nonfinite inputs, intermediate overflow, division by zero and invalid roots reject the job on CPU before dispatch. Bit identity is to this specified rounded algorithm, not exact real arithmetic or other library reduction orders.
validation_method: Full byte comparison against independent exact-rational RN32 CPU oracle; analytic, adversarial and held-out vectors; arithmetic tested separately.
